title: E0099: Disable Functions Bypass
plain_english: If `disable_functions` is not configured in `php.ini`, dangerous PHP functions remain available after code execution is achieved.
why_matters: `disable_functions` reduces the attack surface. Even if an attacker injects code, disabling dangerous functions can make it harder to run shell commands or perform other high-risk operations.
bad_example:
// php.ini: disable_functions not set (empty)
// All functions remain available
what_it_checks: `php.ini` cannot be read directly by the rule
`ini_set('disable_functions', ...)` is `PHP_INI_SYSTEM` and cannot be changed at runtime
